A.name: Jedaiah
A.line: priest (1CH 9:10, NEH 7:39, NEH 12:6), of the house of Jeshua (EZR 2:36)
family: priest-of yhvh (YHVH, the God of Israel)
descendant-of aaron (Aaron, brother of Moses (EXO 4:14) and Levitical priest (EXO 28:1))

B.name: Jedaiah
B.line: Priestly family head whose descendants returned with Zerubbabel, house of Jeshua
family: descendant-of jeshua (Jeshua, ninth-chosen priest for the twenty-four courses (1CH 24:11))

why: בְּנֵי יְדַעְיָה לְבֵית יֵשׁוּעַ identifies a priestly ancestral family of the house of Jeshua, matching B’s description of the head whose descendants returned. A also shares these identifying facts, so the verse alone does not securely distinguish the two records.
